In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +22.5 and R +8.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is R +18.2. Your best recent poll is Advanced Targeting Research at D +4.1; your worst is Peak Insights (R) at R +22.1. 4 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Ada, a projected net 28,436 votes; Blaine, a projected net 5,450 votes; Latah, a projected net 3,396 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Todd Achilles runs furthest behind in Bonner, Idaho, Kootenai. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 92% of voters, 38 to 56, where a 5 point gain is worth 4.59 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 64% of voters, 39 to 54, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.23 points; Voters without a degree, 64% of voters, 34 to 59, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.23 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Todd Achilles: Immigration voters 13 to 80, Small counties 32 to 61, Midsize counties 33 to 59. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$194K cash against $3.5M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
